headline: Mehmet Şimşek announced: Tax audits to closely monitor high-income and large taxpayers | Economy
summary: The Tax Inspection Board increased audits of large-scale taxpayers this year. The audit rate for large taxpayers has risen to 31.3%, according to Finance Minister Mehmet Şimşek.
why: Tax enforcement on large companies and high earners affects corporate compliance costs and government revenue collection.
